PROJECTS.md milestone 9 (`project-pages`) follow-up: four more project home pages now carry a figure from their own output. Each `experiments/figure.py` parses the committed `results.txt` (nothing retyped) and writes a grouped-bar SVG: add16 cells×depth by ABC script, cells×cycles per vector by design and batch size, reserve-price gain by buyer value, and share of first-best surplus under limited liability.

Checked: `python site/build.py` prints `ok` (407 projects); each SVG parses as XML; two were rendered and viewed in Chromium; figures appear on the generated project pages. No results changed. `mirror-sync` was skipped because oss-monorepo#7037 already claims it.
